picks.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction - Development and External Validation in Prospective Multicenter Cohorts
picks.rationale: A digital-stethoscope AI that finds left ventricular dysfunction at the point of care, validated externally in prospective multicenter patient cohorts. It is a screening tool any clinic with a stethoscope could use.
picks.excerpt: NEJM AI original article: an AI model on digital-stethoscope heart sounds detects left ventricular dysfunction at the point of care, developed and externally validated in prospective multicenter patient cohorts - a screening route for asymptomatic LVD where early treatment improves outcomes. (Online date via Crossref.)

picks.title: SimBioSys Secures FDA Clearance for TumorSight Risk, the first AI-powered, MRI-derived breast cancer recurrence risk assessment
picks.rationale: A new FDA clearance for AI that estimates breast cancer recurrence risk from the pre-surgery MRI. That is a regulator decision affecting how oncologists plan treatment.
picks.excerpt: FDA cleared SimBioSys's TumorSight Risk, AI software that estimates breast cancer recurrence risk from a patient's pre-surgery MRI. Off-list source: covered by ABC News / Diagnostic Imaging but not by any reachable allowed-domain outlet.

picks.title: AI Native EMR 시대 여는 'BITMate AI' 선보인다
picks.rationale: A Korean EMR vendor is launching an AI charting agent for clinics and hospitals that covers visit summaries, voice charting and the prescription flow. It changes documentation at the point of care.
picks.excerpt: 비트컴퓨터가 KIMES BUSAN 2026에서 AI 진료 에이전트 'BITMate AI'를 선보인다. 내원요약·보이스차팅·맞춤 AI 에이전트로 진료 중 대화 인식부터 기록 생성, 처방 흐름까지 실시간으로 잇는 의원·병원용 EMR이다.

picks.title: Reporting completeness of clinical trials evaluating large language model interventions in medicine: systematic review
picks.rationale: A BMJ systematic review checks how fully LLM clinical trials report their model, prompts and outcomes against CONSORT-AI. Anyone reading or running these trials can use it as an evidence-quality check.
picks.excerpt: BMJ systematic review and meta-research study grading clinical trials of LLM interventions in medicine against established reporting guidelines (CONSORT-AI etc.), finding how completely they describe the model, prompts, and patient outcomes.

picks.title: Large language models for depression assessment from brief daily diaries
picks.rationale: LLMs score depression severity from patients' short free-text diaries, offering an alternative to repeated questionnaires for tracking patients over time.
picks.excerpt: npj Digital Medicine study scoring depression severity from patients' brief free-text daily diaries with LLMs, as an alternative to repeated self-report questionnaires for intensive longitudinal tracking in clinical research and practice.
